ext.description: Your Claude companion in VS Code: live usage and rate-limit monitoring for Claude Code (session, weekly, Opus, Sonnet) in the sidebar and status bar, with threshold alerts and paid-credit tracking. Includes Claude Vault, an encrypted local store that lets Claude use your API keys and secrets without ever seeing them, in shell commands and MCP tools.
cap.untrusted: The extension only reads the local OAuth token and never runs workspace code.
cfg.autoConnect: Wire Claude Code automatically when the extension starts: hooks installed, local MCP servers routed through the vault proxy. Turn this off to keep Claude Code untouched until you press Connect yourself, which you will then have to do at every start.
cfg.pollSeconds: Seconds between API calls. A cache shared across every VS Code window means one real request feeds them all.
cfg.alerts: Notify when the 5-hour session reaches 80% then 95%, and the weekly limit 90%.
cfg.statusBar: Show usage in the status bar.
cfg.pauseWhenExhausted: When a limit is exhausted, suspend API calls until the reset time Anthropic reports, instead of polling for nothing. The refresh button overrides the pause.
cfg.showCredits: Show paid credits spent beyond the plan, when extra usage is enabled on the Claude account.
cmd.vault.autoApprove: Let Claude replace keys without asking
cfg.badge: Show a badge with the session percentage on the activity-bar icon.
cfg.statusBarPosition: Which side of the status bar shows the usage figure.
cfg.statusBarStyle: How the status-bar figure looks: a prominent coloured pill, or custom text that follows your colour bands over an untouched background.
cfg.statusBarWeek: Also show the weekly limit in the status bar, after the session.
cfg.location: Where the panel lives: the secondary side bar on the right, next to the chat, or the activity bar on the left. The mirror button in the panel title bar switches sides too.
cmd.moveToPrimary: Move back to the left side bar
welcome.movedRight:
The panel is next to the chat.
[Bring it back to the left](command:claudeLimits.moveToPrimary)
cmd.vault.replace: Replace the value of a key
cmd.vault.checkCommit: Check what is staged for commit
cfg.statusBarStyle.prominent: A coloured pill at all times, amber then red near a limit.
cfg.statusBarStyle.subtle: No pill: the text colour follows the bands, from grey to red, over the theme background.
cfg.statusBarBands: Colour bands for the custom style. Each band runs up to its percentage and the next one starts there, so gaps and overlaps cannot occur. Only the text is coloured; the background is left alone. Easier to set from the extension settings page, which draws the scale.
cfg.statusBarBands.upTo: The percentage this band reaches. The last one is always 100.
cfg.statusBarBands.color: A theme colour, so it stays readable in light and dark alike.
cfg.projectionSession: Show when the 5-hour session will be exhausted, based on current consumption slope. Disabled by default because the forecast is most useful only when the slope is steep.
cfg.projectionWeek: Show when the weekly limit will be exhausted, based on current consumption slope. Disabled by default because weekly patterns vary too much for reliable forecasting.
